PHASE 0 — KNOW THE BATTLEFIELD (hardened spec)
A. HARDENING DELTAS — what the deep-think caught
These are corrections to the v1 "7 worktree agents" plan. Each is a real failure mode I'd otherwise have walked us into:
1. KILL THE WORKTREES (the biggest correction). A census is read-only, and worktrees check out a clean copy — they would map the last-committed state, not your live working tree (which has uncommitted reality in it). Mapping a worktree = mapping a lie. All Phase 0 agents read canonical D:\OB-1-CANONICAL directly. Parallelism for readers needs no isolation; conflict is impossible because each agent writes only its own distinct output file. Worktrees were solving a write-isolation problem that doesn't exist here.
2. EVIDENCE-OR-UNKNOWN GATE (anti-hallucination). The way this census dies quietly is an agent writing "🟢 GREEN — looks wired" with no proof. Rule: no verdict is valid without evidence coordinates (file:line or command → result). A verdict lacking evidence is auto-recorded as UNKNOWN, never GREEN. This is the single most important hardening line. It converts "I think" into "here's line 2270."
3. DOMAIN OWNERSHIP BY PATH (no double-count, no gaps). D4/D5/D6 overlap — a skill is also a doc, a script is also a file. Undefined boundaries = two agents map the same thing differently, or nobody maps it. Hard ownership by path/extension (table below). Every file belongs to exactly one domain.
4. D7 IS NOT A REPO READ. Cloudflare workers/D1/KV/R2/secrets cannot be known from files — they need live wrangler/CF-API/status-endpoint probes. I'd mislabeled it as parallel-equivalent to the others. It's the one domain touching live systems, with its own probe command set, and it should use the Cloudflare MCP (now connected) or wrangler CLI.
5. CROSS-DOMAIN SEAMS NEED AN OWNER. The unresolved SOUL→DNA endpoint spans D2+D3. The corrupt inverted-index spans D3 (data) + D4 (the script that corrupts it). Without explicit seam ownership these fall between agents and never get mapped. Explicit seam registry below.
6. COVERAGE IS A NUMBER, NOT A FEELING. Each domain declares its inventory denominator up front (e.g. "47 src files, 41 routes") and reports mapped / total. "I got most of it" is not an exit condition. ≥95% or the gap is listed as UNKNOWN with a reason.
7. BREADTH BEFORE DEPTH (token discipline). index.js alone is ~4,800 lines; an agent that reads everything overflows and degrades. Mandate: inventory via grep/glob first, then targeted evidence-reads only. Cheapest sufficient proof per verdict. No whole-file reads.
B. THE UNIVERSAL ROW SCHEMA (every agent emits this exact shape)
{
  "domain": "D1",
  "piece": "vocab-srs / spaced repetition",
  "type": "module|route|page|endpoint|artifact|script|skill|binding|worker|doc",
  "verdict": "GREEN|AMBER|RED|GHOST|UNKNOWN",
  "connectivity_test": "the specific loop checked, in words",
  "evidence": ["src/index.js:16 import", "src/index.js:2270 computeNextReview called",
               "public/chat.js:1397 calls /api/vocab/due", "review caller: test-portal.html:290 ONLY"],
  "gap": "review write-back not wired from live voice session; intervals frozen at day 1",
  "fix_recommendation": "wire chat.js to POST /api/vocab/review with grade after due-word exchange",
  "fix_effort": "S|M|L",
  "seam_with": ["D3"]
}
Output file per domain: OPERATIONS/BATTLEFIELD/D{N}-matrix.json (array of rows). Mechanical merge guaranteed by the fixed schema.
C. VERDICT RUBRIC (testable, not vibes)
Verdict	Definition	Required evidence
🟢 GREEN	Exists, wired, loop closes, exercised in the live path	the full chain cited, incl. the write-back/consumer
🟠 AMBER	Exists, plumbed, but loop half-open OR only test/admin path closes it	the break point cited (e.g. "review caller = test only")
🔴 RED	Orphaned import / dead route / stub handler / missing artifact	the absence proven (no caller found / handler returns stub)
⚫ GHOST	Deployed or present but nothing references it	zero inbound references across repo + infra
❓ UNKNOWN	Could not verify within scope	reason + what's needed to resolve
D. THE SEVEN DOMAINS (scope-bounded)
#	Domain	Path ownership (exclusive)	Inventory denominator	Connectivity test
D1	Runtime app	APPS/NET-PET-AI/src/**, APPS/NET-PET-AI/public/**	all src modules, all routes (path ===), all pages	import → called → loop closes → live consumer. + verify AD-1/2/3: no external LLM in audio path
D2	Soul system	soul-logger worker, SCRIPTS/session-capture.ps1	all /api/soul/* endpoints	does session-capture fire on stop? is soulcount the live query? owns the SOUL→DNA endpoint resolution
D3	Pipeline chain	RRL/, CANON/HEAVY-LEDGER/, CANON/STARMAP/, CANON/SOUL-KEYWORDS/, CANON/PHEROMONES/, CANON/PIPELINE/, CANON/REINCARNATION/	8 stages × runs 0–42	per-run artifact present? merkle intact? inverted-index valid JSON? rfkw-search returns hits?
D4	Automation	SCRIPTS/** (.ps1/.mjs/.cjs/.js)	all script files	wired into a protocol or orphaned? runs clean? owns registry↔context-bundle decoupling
D5	Skills/commands	.claude/commands/**, .kilo/command/** (canonical only — exclude .kilo/worktrees/**)	all command files	does the skill match live system reality? duplicates? the death-protocol divergence
D6	Knowledge	all **/*.md NOT owned by D3/D5, excl. .kilo/worktrees/**, node_modules/**	all canon docs	REGISTRY v2 rubric: REGISTER/REFERENCE/DATA/DUPLICATE/ARCHIVE. this IS the registry sweep
D7	CF infra	live (not repo)	all workers, D1, KV, R2, DO, secrets	deployed AND referenced? via Cloudflare MCP / wrangler list / /api/status. GHOST detection
Exclusions, global: .kilo/worktrees/** (12 stale clones — D5 maps their existence as GHOST candidates, nobody reads their contents), .git/**, node_modules/**.
E. CROSS-DOMAIN SEAMS (explicit owner — these fall between agents otherwise)
Seam	Owner	Consumer	Question
SOUL→DNA endpoint	D2	D3	GET /api/soul/session/{run} vs POST /api/soul/extract — which is live? (Run 34 fix claim)
inverted-index corruption	D4 (writer script)	D3 (data)	does build-soulkeys / death STEP 6 produce valid JSON or -Append garbage?
registry ↔ context-bundle	D4 (script)	D6 (registry doc)	does the script read the registry or hard-code paths?
Deepgram anti-drift law	D1 (audio path)	D6 (the law doc)	is the live path compliant AND is the law in the registry?
reincarnation v5.0	D5 (skill files)	D3 (artifacts)	did Kilo's v5.0 changes land correctly? does REINCARNATION-CONTRACT.md exist & match?
That last seam matters now: the skill descriptions already show v5.0 redirects — something changed the reincarnation files between turns. The census must verify what actually landed vs what we specified.
F. THE MERGE (7 → 1) — done by OB1 next session
Ingest OPERATIONS/BATTLEFIELD/D{1-7}-matrix.json.
Produce CANON/SYSTEM/BATTLEFIELD-MAP.md (human) + system-map.json (machine).
Emit a ranked fix list sorted by (verdict severity × fix_effort⁻¹) — RED-Small first, the cheap high-impact wins.
Append a BATTLEFIELD STATE rollup to COLD-START-BOOT.md: counts per verdict per domain + link. Every future RISE now boots knowing the battlefield.
Register BATTLEFIELD-MAP.md in mandatory-reads.json (D6 product folds in here).
G. EXECUTION MODEL
- 7 agents, parallel, NO worktrees, all read canonical D:\OB-1-CANONICAL.
- Each writes ONLY OPERATIONS/BATTLEFIELD/D{N}-matrix.json. No other writes.
- LAW: READ-ONLY. MAP, DON'T FIX. A found fix → fix_recommendation field, never applied.
- D7 may run read-only live probes (wrangler list / CF MCP / GET /api/status). No mutations.
- Breadth before depth: grep/glob inventory first, targeted evidence-reads only.
H. EXIT GATE (Phase 0 is trustworthy only when ALL true)
	7 matrices present and schema-valid
	Coverage ≥95% per domain, or gaps listed as UNKNOWN with reason
	Zero verdicts without evidence (the anti-hallucination invariant)
	All 5 seams resolved to a verdict
	Merged BATTLEFIELD-MAP.md + ranked fix list + COLD-START-BOOT rollup produced
Only when this gate passes → Phase 0b (fix AMBER/RED) → TRACK A/B. Map first, build on GREEN.
That's the hardened census. The deep-think's core moves: no worktrees (map truth, not a clean copy), evidence-or-UNKNOWN (no hallucinated GREEN), path-exclusive domain ownership (no gaps/double-counts), explicit seam owners (the cross-cutting bugs get caught), and a measurable exit gate.
For the Sonnet audit pass next: the things worth scrutinizing are — (1) whether the reincarnation v5.0 changes Kilo apparently already made actually match the blueprint and the contract file exists (seam in §E), (2) whether D6's rubric and the earlier REGISTRY v2 spec are fully consistent, and (3) whether any blueprint we handed Kilo assumes a piece this census might return RED — because if it does, that blueprint is built on sand and should wait for the map.
